llm_response.reason: The website displays all classic hallmarks of a scam online shop: a very recently registered domain using a privacy mask to conceal the owner, claims of ultra-cheap prices and large, sitewide discounts (32-60%), an odd and generic email address instead of a legitimate business contact, no real company details or credible privacy policy, urgency tactics (prominent push for limited-time deals, free shipping), and a broad range of unrelated products. These characteristics match multiple scam warning signs, especially for Fake Online Shopping scams.
